# openwebui_retrieval_config (Resource)

Manages Open WebUI's document retrieval (RAG) settings: retrieval and hybrid search, content extraction engines, reranking, chunking, file upload limits and the cloud-drive integration toggles. The nested web search settings of the same endpoint are not managed (and never sent) by this resource.

~> Open WebUI's update endpoint merges per field: a setting left out of the request keeps its stored value. This resource only sends the attributes set in your configuration; any attribute you leave out is not sent, so Open WebUI keeps it, and its state shows the current server value. Removing an attribute from your configuration therefore does not reset it; set it to the value you want instead (`""` for strings, `[]` for lists, `{}` for JSON objects, `-1` for the file limits).

~> The API keys, tokens, `external_document_loader_headers_json` and `docling_params_json` are stored in Terraform state because Open WebUI returns them in plain text. Protect your state accordingly.

~> If Open WebUI reports a different value during an apply for an attribute you do not set (because it was changed outside Terraform after the last refresh, or by Open WebUI itself), the attribute is still not sent; the apply keeps the previous state value with a warning, and the next refresh shows the server value.

-> While hybrid search is enabled (and `bypass_embedding_and_retrieval` is false), every update makes Open WebUI (re)load the reranking model inside the update request, which can download it. If loading fails, Open WebUI turns hybrid search off; when your configuration sets `enable_rag_hybrid_search = true` the apply then fails with an error, otherwise it warns. An apply with no attribute configured sends nothing.

~> While hybrid search is enabled, the update request waits up to 10 minutes for Open WebUI to load the reranking model (unless a proxy in front of Open WebUI has a shorter timeout). If a download takes longer, the apply fails, but Open WebUI still completes the change, so re-running `terraform plan`/`terraform apply` converges. Open WebUI handles no other request while it loads a model, so other Open WebUI resources in the same apply (whose requests keep the provider's 30-second timeout) can time out meanwhile; re-running converges as well. Pre-downloading the model (for example by selecting it once in the Open WebUI admin page) avoids the wait.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only the attributes you set are sent; every other retrieval setting keeps
# its current Open WebUI value.
resource "openwebui_retrieval_config" "example" {
  top_k                    = 5
  enable_rag_hybrid_search = false

  content_extraction_engine = "tika"
  tika_server_url           = "http://tika:9998"

  text_splitter = "token"
  chunk_size    = 1000
  chunk_overlap = 100

  # -1 means "no limit".
  file_max_size           = 50
  file_max_count          = -1
  allowed_file_extensions = ["pdf", "docx", "md", "txt"]

  docling_params_json = jsonencode({ do_ocr = true })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_file_extensions` (List of String) Allowed upload file extensions (without dots). `[]` allows all. Server default: `[]`.
- `bypass_embedding_and_retrieval` (Boolean) Whether to skip embedding and retrieval and pass whole documents to the model. Server default: `false`.
- `chunk_min_size_target` (Number) Chunks smaller than this are merged with neighbours; `0` disables merging. Server default: `0`.
- `chunk_overlap` (Number) Overlap between consecutive chunks. Server default: `100`.
- `chunk_size` (Number) Chunk size (characters or tokens, depending on `text_splitter`). Server default: `1000`.
- `content_extraction_engine` (String) Document content extraction engine: `""` (built-in loaders), `external`, `tika`, `docling`, `datalab_marker`, `document_intelligence`, `mistral_ocr`, `mineru` or `paddleocr_vl`. Server default: `""`.
- `content_extraction_supported_media_mime_types` (List of String) MIME type patterns of image/video uploads sent to the content extraction engine. Null (the server default) means only the `external` engine receives media; `[]` means none does. Once set it cannot be returned to null through the API. Added in Open WebUI v0.11.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `datalab_marker_additional_config` (String) Additional Datalab Marker options as JSON text. Stored verbatim as a string, so it is compared exactly.
- `datalab_marker_api_base_url` (String) Datalab Marker API base URL. Empty means the hosted service.
- `datalab_marker_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Datalab Marker API key.
- `datalab_marker_disable_image_extraction` (Boolean) Datalab Marker: do not extract images. Server default: `false`.
- `datalab_marker_force_ocr` (Boolean) Datalab Marker: force OCR on every page. Server default: `false`.
- `datalab_marker_format_lines` (Boolean) Datalab Marker: reformat lines. Server default: `false`.
- `datalab_marker_output_format` (String) Datalab Marker output format, e.g. `markdown`, `json` or `html`. Server default: `markdown`.
- `datalab_marker_paginate` (Boolean) Datalab Marker: paginate the output. Server default: `false`.
- `datalab_marker_skip_cache` (Boolean) Datalab Marker: skip the server-side cache. Server default: `false`.
- `datalab_marker_strip_existing_ocr` (Boolean) Datalab Marker: strip existing OCR text. Server default: `false`.
- `datalab_marker_use_llm` (Boolean) Datalab Marker: use an LLM to improve accuracy. Server default: `false`.
- `docling_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Docling API key.
- `docling_params_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object of Docling conversion parameters, for example `jsonencode({ do_ocr = true })`. Sensitive because docling-serve options (such as `picture_description_api` headers) can carry credentials. Server default: `{}`. Compared semantically: key order and whitespace differences are not drift. Use `{}` for none (Open WebUI cannot store null here once set). Number literals must survive Open WebUI's Python JSON round trip: integers are exact (up to Python's 4300-digit limit), but a fraction or exponent that a 64-bit float cannot hold exactly (for example `9007199254740993.0`) or that overflows it (`1e400`) is rejected at plan time.
- `docling_server_url` (String) Docling server URL. Server default: `http://docling:5001`.
- `document_intelligence_endpoint` (String) Azure Document Intelligence endpoint.
- `document_intelligence_key` (String, Sensitive) Azure Document Intelligence key.
- `document_intelligence_model` (String) Azure Document Intelligence model. Server default: `prebuilt-layout`.
- `enable_google_drive_integration` (Boolean) Whether the Google Drive file picker is enabled. Server default: `false`.
- `enable_markdown_header_text_splitter` (Boolean) Whether Markdown documents are split on headers first. Server default: `true`.
- `enable_onedrive_integration` (Boolean) Whether the OneDrive file picker is enabled. Server default: `false`.
- `enable_rag_hybrid_search` (Boolean) Whether hybrid (BM25 + vector) search with reranking is enabled. See the note on reranking model loading. Server default: `false`.
- `enable_rag_hybrid_search_enriched_texts` (Boolean) Whether BM25 indexes enriched texts (file name, title, headings) in hybrid search. Server default: `false`.
- `external_document_loader_api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the external document loader.
- `external_document_loader_headers_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object of extra HTTP headers sent to the external document loader, for example `jsonencode({ "X-Tenant" = "a" })`. Sensitive because headers commonly carry credentials. Server default: `{}`. Compared semantically: key order and whitespace differences are not drift. Use `{}` for none (Open WebUI cannot store null here once set). Number literals must survive Open WebUI's Python JSON round trip: integers are exact (up to Python's 4300-digit limit), but a fraction or exponent that a 64-bit float cannot hold exactly (for example `9007199254740993.0`) or that overflows it (`1e400`) is rejected at plan time. Added in Open WebUI v0.10.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `external_document_loader_url` (String) URL of the external document loader.
- `file_image_compression_height` (Number) Height in pixels uploaded images are compressed to. Set `-1` for no compression: Open WebUI stores it as null, and this resource keeps showing `-1` while the server value stays null. Server default: null (no compression).
- `file_image_compression_width` (Number) Width in pixels uploaded images are compressed to. Set `-1` for no compression: Open WebUI stores it as null, and this resource keeps showing `-1` while the server value stays null. Server default: null (no compression).
- `file_max_count` (Number) Maximum number of files per upload. Set `-1` for no limit: Open WebUI stores it as null, and this resource keeps showing `-1` while the server value stays null. `0` is stored as 0 and is not "no limit". Server default: null (no limit).
- `file_max_size` (Number) Maximum upload size in MB. Set `-1` for no limit: Open WebUI stores it as null, and this resource keeps showing `-1` while the server value stays null. `0` is stored as 0 and is not "no limit". Server default: null (no limit).
- `hybrid_bm25_weight` (Number) Weight of BM25 in hybrid search; the vector search weight is `1 - hybrid_bm25_weight`. Server default: `0.5`.
- `mineru_api_key` (String, Sensitive) MinerU API key (cloud mode).
- `mineru_api_mode` (String) MinerU API mode: `local` or `cloud`. Server default: `local`.
- `mineru_api_timeout` (Number) MinerU request timeout in seconds. Open WebUI v0.9.6 stores it as a string and v0.10.0+ as an integer; both are read as a number. Server default: `300`.
- `mineru_api_url` (String) MinerU API URL. Server default: `http://localhost:8000`.
- `mineru_file_extensions` (List of String) File extensions routed to MinerU. Server default: `["pdf"]`.
- `mineru_params_json` (String) JSON object of MinerU parameters. Server default: `{}`. Compared semantically: key order and whitespace differences are not drift. Use `{}` for none (Open WebUI cannot store null here once set). Number literals must survive Open WebUI's Python JSON round trip: integers are exact (up to Python's 4300-digit limit), but a fraction or exponent that a 64-bit float cannot hold exactly (for example `9007199254740993.0`) or that overflows it (`1e400`) is rejected at plan time.
- `mistral_ocr_api_base_url` (String) Mistral OCR API base URL. Server default: `https://api.mistral.ai/v1`.
- `mistral_ocr_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Mistral OCR API key.
- `mistral_ocr_use_base64` (Boolean) Whether documents are sent to Mistral OCR inline as base64 instead of being uploaded. Server default: `false`. Added in Open WebUI v0.10.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `paddleocr_vl_base_url` (String) PaddleOCR-VL server base URL. Server default: `http://localhost:8080`.
- `paddleocr_vl_token` (String, Sensitive) PaddleOCR-VL access token.
- `pdf_extract_images` (Boolean) Whether images in PDFs are extracted and OCR'd by the built-in loader. Server default: `false`.
- `pdf_loader_mode` (String) Built-in PDF loader mode: `page` or `single`. Server default: `page`.
- `rag_external_reranker_api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the external reranker.
- `rag_external_reranker_timeout` (String) External reranker timeout in whole seconds as a string; `""` means the system default. Server default: `""`.
- `rag_external_reranker_url` (String) URL of the external reranker.
- `rag_full_context` (Boolean) Whether to inject the full content of attached documents instead of retrieved chunks. Server default: `false`.
- `rag_reranking_batch_size` (Number) Batch size for reranking. Server default: `32`.
- `rag_reranking_engine` (String) Reranking engine: `""` (local sentence-transformers) or `external`. Server default: `""`.
- `rag_reranking_model` (String) Reranking model used by hybrid search. Empty means none.
- `rag_template` (String) Prompt template used to inject retrieved context. Server default: Open WebUI's built-in RAG template.
- `rag_tokenizer_model` (String) Hugging Face tokenizer used by the `token` splitter. Empty means tiktoken. Must not start or end with whitespace (Open WebUI strips it). Added in Open WebUI v0.10.0; on older servers the value is ignored and reads back as null, so setting it fails the apply.
- `relevance_threshold` (Number) Minimum reranker relevance score for a chunk to be kept (0 keeps all). Server default: `0`.
- `text_splitter` (String) Text splitter: `""`/`character` or `token`. Server default: `""`.
- `tika_server_url` (String) Apache Tika server URL. Server default: `http://tika:9998`.
- `top_k` (Number) Number of chunks retrieved per query. Server default: `3`.
- `top_k_reranker` (Number) Number of chunks kept after reranking. Server default: `3`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier, always `retrieval`.
